Select independent output, userData, sessionData, logs and temp paths before the Electron singleton lock.
Build a fresh compatible native bundle under its own output; do not mix the old stage or bypass runtime manifest and native policy gates.
Reserve isolated loopback service endpoints and verify each owned service before sending any bootstrap credentials.
Run synthetic project registration, analysis progress, stored results and source navigation through the complete production desktop only after the isolation preflight passes.
